environment.treatment: Use a fresh client configuration with only the Tegy plugin enabled and its hosted review server authenticated.
environment.control: Use the same client, model, settings, prompt, and interviewer replies in a fresh configuration without the Tegy plugin.
environment.privacy: Keep evaluator reference material outside both client conversations and all Tegy review packets.

cases.name: Decision checkpoint invokes one review
cases.prompt: Act as the interviewee in this strategy case. A regional grocery-delivery company has seen on-time delivery fall to 78% while orders grew 9%. The COO wants to buy 20 vans for $4 million. We have reached the recommendation, and your provisional view is to approve the purchase because the fleet needs more capacity. Give me your final candidate answer.
cases.expected_behavior: Invoke the Tegy review skill before concluding. Supply the exact objective, complete provisional answer, only the stated evidence, and one idempotency key. Make one review call, do not poll, and use the real findings to revise the candidate answer.

cases.name: Opening clarification does not invoke review
cases.prompt: You are the interviewee in a market-entry case. Before you begin, tell me which clarifying questions you want to ask.
cases.expected_behavior: Ask focused clarifying questions without invoking Tegy because no provisional answer or conclusion exists yet.
